# 1 Enoch Chapter 72 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 72 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 72:1 — 'portals' vs. 'gates' for Ge'ez astronomical terminology

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "portals of-the-heaven" | Preserves archaic register of astronomical language |
| LOGOS | "gates of heaven" | Standard rendering; 'gates' is more accessible |
| PNEUMA | "gates in the east" | Simplified; drops 'of heaven' as implied |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'gates of heaven' (LOGOS). The Ge'ez 'anqatsa samay is literally 'openings/gates of heaven.' EMET's 'portals' adds unnecessary archaism. PNEUMA's omission of 'of heaven' loses the cosmological framing — these are gates in the firmament, not earthly structures.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Cosmological precision matters in the Astronomical Book.

---

## 72:1 — 'new creation' — eschatological term (Ge'ez 'addis fetra)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-new creation is-accomplished which-dureth till-eternity" | Literal + archaic 'dureth'; preserves the Ge'ez eschatological term |
| LOGOS | "the new creation is accomplished that endures forever" | Same term in modern English |
| PNEUMA | "the new creation that will last forever" | Future tense; 'last forever' is natural English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'the new creation is accomplished that endures forever' (LOGOS). 'New creation' ('addis fetra) is an important eschatological concept linking 1 Enoch to Isaiah 65:17 and 2 Corinthians 5:17. All three preserve the term; LOGOS balances precision and readability.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Intertextual significance — new creation theology.

---
